assets.prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: portrait hero photograph for Moon Woven, a quiet botanical craft atelier website. Create a beautifully art-directed original editorial interior photograph, portrait 2:3 composition. A single handmade crescent-moon dream catcher hanging from a fine natural cord, centered slightly right, large and clearly visible: a substantial organically curved wooden crescent wrapped in rough tan jute, an intricate delicate ivory COTTON spiderweb across the crescent opening, small raw clear quartz chips carefully tied along the frame, pale green aventurine beads, THREE fine hanging cotton strands of different lengths, center strand ending in one softly translucent pale pink faceted rose-quartz point with a small silver cap. The top suspension thread enters from top edge. The entire piece and bottom pendant must be in frame with generous breathing room. NO feathers, no macrame fringes, no tassels. Hanging against a warm ochre ivory limewashed plaster wall, gentle angled afternoon light from left, believable light-and-shadow patterns of a window and a leafy branch in upper left. A narrow ochre-toned linen curtain softly blurred at far right edge. Bottom left only: a small corner of an old dark walnut console, subtle cream handmade ceramic vase holding one sparse olive branch, unobtrusive. The object hangs freely clear of furniture. Quiet spacious premium design magazine photography, real handworked fibers, clear focal detail, fine natural film grain, soft depth, warm whites, moss green leaves, stone and flax neutrals. No text, no logos, no watermark, no collage, no people. Avoid highly saturated color, fantasy magic, celestial illustrations, boho excess and glossy CGI. Authentic tactile elegant photographic image.

Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: wide editorial materials still life for Moon Woven, a quiet botanical dream catcher atelier. Create original refined close-up still-life photograph with a top-down oblique angle, landscape 3:2 composition. On natural oatmeal linen laid over warm limestone: a small wound coil of coarse tan JUTE string at upper left; a loose ivory COTTON thread elegantly making one curved loop through center; a small wooden spool of ivory cotton; a tiny group of irregular milky clear-quartz chips; three softly translucent pale green aventurine beads with actual threading holes; one faceted pale pink rose quartz pendant at lower right. A tiny fresh olive twig at left edge, restrained. Show subtle difference between rough hairy jute and smooth fine cotton. Authentic imperfect natural materials. Afternoon sun from upper left making long soft shadows. Earthy olive, warm paper, flax, pink crystal. Premium still-life editorial photography, tactile macro detail, calm deliberate composition, stylish negative space but not empty. No text, no logos, no watermark, no tools, no hands, no jewelry chain, no fantasy colors, no polished commercial gloss.
